items.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023
items.q: The transcript only shows Monk Rowe as the interviewer introducing himself. The interviewee (Alan Broadbent) does not mention any personal or professional relationship with Monk Rowe in the provided text.

ctx.x: Alan was interviewed via Zoom on October 26, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. It’s a great pleasure to have Alan Broadbent with me today. And I’m going to introduce you first as a pianist, orchestrator, arranger, composer, teacher, and just returned from San Francisco, is that right?
